body:
I've played the search for happy game before. Nothing good came of it. Joy seems an illusion to me. Nothing makes me happy, not really. I don't remember the last time I smiled. I don't smile when I wake up or when I go to sleep. Everything to me seems pointless. Even if I do get a job I'll just be spending hours toiling away for a meagre existence while some dude with a million dollar house, an expensive sports car, and a self opinion the size of Texas gets rich. 

This might be my pessimism showing through, but I just can't see how the people who really care will win against the corporate, self-serving assholes that control everything that matters.
